problems.problem: The regenerated terrazzo still fails the concept's material claim: visible honey-gold/grey-green chip speckle only appears in the lower field (y≈700-1440), while the upper wall (y≈0-480) reads as smooth cream paper grain, and the 'broad calm warm-white band' rendered as a hard-edged bright stripe at y≈490-660 that cuts straight through the first two title lines and the gold dome behind the bottle. Against R4's uniformly tactile mineral grain and R5's seamless sweep, the wall/floor mismatch plus the stripe edge reads as a rendering seam, not one continuous honed stone plane.

The right type column still never closes: logo top y=403, title block ends y=844 and the gold rule sits at y=886, leaving y≈900-1440 of the right half completely empty while the bottle base lands at y=1209. The column therefore floats in the upper half and the declared sundial-tick anchor never relates to the bottle's ground line; versus R1's resolved right-column hierarchy the lower-right void keeps the editorial grid top-loaded.

Contact detail crop [82,1069,565,1319] confirms a real contact shadow at offset_y 0 hugging the glass foot (no floating), but the footprint is still a thin grey slit with almost no vertical spread and no faint ambient occlusion pool in the honed stone around the 302px base, so the heavy glass foot reads pressed onto the surface instead of settled into it, unlike the grounded contact in R5.

Hierarchy inside the column is under-differentiated: the 'Guerlain' logo at size 30 with tracking 6 measures only ~132px wide against 88px title lines, so the brand mark reads as a stray caption rather than a column head; the empty subtitle slot at y=864 also leaves a dead gap between the title block and the gold rule, weakening the column's internal rhythm.

changes.value: Seamless warm bone-white terrazzo interior, one continuous honed stone plane sweeping upward into a distant wall with no horizon and no stripe edges, dense even speckle of fine honey-gold and grey-green mineral chips at identical grain size across the entire field from top edge to bottom edge, matte mineral finish, one very broad gentle gradient of soft warm noon light brightest across the upper third fading gradually with no visible band boundary, empty space only, no objects
